mathematical_audit.complete_moment: The Hasse and transverse orthogonality identities from Item366 give the two top entries. Since p divides q=p^2, summing the constant lower-left entry -1 over q-1 nonzero field elements gives 1, producing C=[[-a,-Q0],[1,0]] exactly.
mathematical_audit.cyclicity: The Krylov matrix [e1,C e1] has determinant one on every row, including the joint-zero locus. Cayley-Hamilton is C^2+aC+Q0 I=0.
mathematical_audit.coordinate_recovery: The characteristic polynomial is X^2+aX+Q0, so -trace and determinant recover the two already forced coordinates with Jacobian one. The determinant is a repackaging of Q0, not an additional condition.
mathematical_audit.minimality: A rank-one characteristic polynomial supplies only one universal coefficient; two algebraically independent coordinates cannot both be recovered rationally from it. Equivalently, one bounded-degree scalar equation cannot have radical (a,Q0). Rank two attains the universal lower bound.
mathematical_audit.unframed_obstruction: For uv nonzero, diagonal scaling conjugates diag(-a,N(u),N(v)) to diag(-a,N(1),N(1)). Hence no conjugacy-functorial unframed construction can recover u+v=-Q0 from Item366's matrix on that stratum.
mathematical_audit.actual_relevance: At (h,s,p)=(10,11,109), u=98 and v=11 are both nonzero but sum to zero, so the transverse-zero event genuinely occurs in the generic Jordan stratum.
mathematical_audit.compatibility_scope: The companion is assembled additively after selecting the two desired moments. It is not a prime-independent local system, multiplicative Frobenius action, or compatible characteristic-zero lift.
mathematical_audit.capacity: Without a horizontal trace-determinant nonconcentration theorem, the full 1/36 ceiling and zero booking remain unchanged.
